payload.recallText: I wrote for the newspaper called the Ram during my time at Fordham University. Dean McGowan wanted to change the type of students that were going to the university to more prestigious ones instead of regular ones. I go to ask the Dean if that rumor is true and as I stood there I see this pie coming out of nowhere and hitting him in the face. I give it a second and then change my question to ask about the pie attack that just happened. i remember the Dean specifically told me that what they thought was "fuck you." I ran to the head of the newspaper to see if I should print the story and he said it was a great idea considering the Dean was a dick. I go to write the story for the paper and figured I should just hide the story in plain sight because attacking the Dean directly wasn't something I was comfortable with. I went on to write the story and call the person Pie Man as if it was something made up. After the story got published I got a mysterious note telling me where the next pie attack would be and with who. I was there at the 3pm waiting to catch the action when bam! out of nowhere a pie hits a prestigious student that was against people drinking at campus barbecues. Then I went to a bar and saw a girl I like and she came to ask me if I was Pie Man because it's like I always knew where he was going to be and I thought about it for a second, but knew the perks that would come with me saying yes. In conclusion, I admitted to being Pie Man and she asked me if I would get her a drink.
